title: 5 Tech Stocks Holding Their Ground Through the AI Trade Pullback
excerpt: Amid the AI-driven Nasdaq correction, Datadog, HPE, Dell, NetApp, and Cisco have shown relative technical strength, with most trading near highs ahead of ear...
content_html:
Ryan Hasson, MarketBeat

Mon, August 3, 2026 at 11:30 AM EDT 8 min read

Key Points

  • Interested in Datadog, Inc.? Here are five stocks we like better.

  • Despite a broader AI-driven selloff pushing the Nasdaq toward correction territory, Datadog, HPE, Dell, NetApp, and Cisco have shown notable technical resilience.

  • With one exception, each stock carries strong year-to-date gains and a Moderate Buy consensus rating or better.

  • All five companies report earnings within about six weeks of each other, from Datadog on Aug. 6 through Dell's estimated Sept. 3 report.

The AI trade hit a rough patch in late July, with chip and AI-infrastructure names leading the Nasdaq toward correction territory. Semiconductor and memory stocks bore the brunt of the selling, as investors questioned whether near-term returns can justify the scale of AI capital spending. Enterprise technology, be it hardware or software, has not been immune to the pressure, but not every name has cracked under it. A handful of stocks tied to data, storage, networking, and hybrid IT infrastructure have held their footing better than the broader tech tape, with some trading within striking distance of new highs even as sentiment sours elsewhere.

Five stocks in particular all fall into that group. Each has its own story, from analyst upgrades to earnings-driven pauses to a top-ranked spot within MarketBeat's own scoring system. Still, all five have shown impressive technical resilience and notable relative strength.

Datadog: Riding an Upgrade Wave Toward New Highs

Datadog (NASDAQ: DDOG) shares jumped almost 8% in a week after a wave of price target increases from Wall Street analysts, a move that stood out against a backdrop of broader tech weakness. The cloud monitoring and observability company closed last week at $267.97, close to its 52-week and all-time high of $278.76. The stock has climbed about 100% year to date, a run that has pushed its market capitalization to nearly $100 billion.

The stock carries a Moderate Buy consensus rating from 46 analysts, with an average price target of $268.61. Now, the stock trades at a steep valuation relative to earnings. With a trailing price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio above 700, the bull case here leans heavily on continued acceleration in AI-driven demand for its platform rather than on traditional value metrics.

→ Financials Hit Record Highs as the AI Trade Unravels—Can They Keep Leading?

MarketBeat's MarketRank places Datadog in the 75th percentile among all companies it evaluates, a solid but not exceptional score weighed down somewhat by recent insider selling from company directors. Datadog is scheduled to report earnings on Aug. 6, and that print will likely decide whether the recent strength translates into a fierce momentum breakout. After months of sideways action, participants will want to see the stock convincingly clear resistance and hold above $280.

content_html_zh:
瑞安·哈森，MarketBeat

2026 年 8 月 3 日星期一，美国东部时间上午 11:30 阅读 8 分钟

要点

  • 对 Datadog, Inc. 感兴趣？ 这是我们更喜欢的五只股票。
  • 尽管人工智能驱动的更广泛抛售将纳斯达克指数推向修正区间，但 Datadog、HPE、戴尔、NetApp 和思科都表现出了显着的技术弹性。
  • 除一只例外外，每只股票今年迄今均取得强劲涨幅，并获得“适度买入”或更高的共识评级。
  • 从 Datadog 8 月 6 日到戴尔 9 月 3 日预估报告，所有五家公司都在大约六周内公布了收益报告。

7 月下旬，人工智能交易遇到了困难，芯片和人工智能基础设施公司引领纳斯达克指数走向调整区间。 半导体和内存股首当其冲，因为投资者质疑近期回报是否能够证明人工智能资本支出规模的合理性。 企业技术，无论是硬件还是软件，都未能幸免于压力，但并非每个名字都在压力下崩溃。 与数据、存储、网络和混合 IT 基础设施相关的少数股票比更广泛的科技股更好地站稳了脚跟，即使其他地方的情绪恶化，一些股票的交易价格仍接近新高。

特别是有五只股票都属于这一类。 每个都有自己的故事，从分析师升级到盈利驱动的暂停，再到 MarketBeat 自己的评分系统中的顶级排名。 尽管如此，这五家公司都表现出了令人印象深刻的技术弹性和显着的相对实力。

→ SpaceX 的第一份收益报告可能决定空头还是多头拥有控制权

Datadog：乘着升级浪潮迈向新高

在华尔街分析师一波上调目标价后，Datadog（纳斯达克股票代码：DDOG）股价一周内上涨近 8%，这一举措在科技股整体疲软的背景下显得尤为突出。 这家云监控和可观察性公司上周收盘价为 267.97 美元，接近其 52 周历史新高 278.76 美元。 今年迄今为止，该股已上涨约 100%，市值已接近 1000 亿美元。

该股获得 46 名分析师的一致评级为“适度买入”，平均目标价为 268.61 美元。 现在，该股票的交易估值相对于收益而言很高。 由于追踪市盈率 (P/E) 超过 700，这里的牛市在很大程度上依赖于人工智能驱动的对其平台的需求的持续加速，而不是传统的价值指标。

→ 随着人工智能贸易的解体，金融股创下历史新高——它们能否继续领先？

MarketBeat 的 MarketRank 将 Datadog 在其评估的所有公司中排在第 75 位，这个分数虽然不错，但并不出色，但由于最近公司董事的内幕抛售，在一定程度上压低了分数。 Datadog 定于 8 月 6 日公布收益报告，该报告可能会决定近期的强势是否会转化为强劲的势头突破。 经过数月的横盘整理，参与者将希望看到该股令人信服地清除阻力并保持在 280 美元上方。
